elements.description: An AI chat input above a glass keyboard and a moving gradient floor; the prompt types itself, key by key.

properties.name: prompts
properties.default: ["Find a quiet hike near Zermatt", "Plan a sunrise climb for Saturday", "What should I pack for two days?"]
properties.description: Prompts the demo types one after another, once each – each one is sent with Enter

properties.name: placeholder
properties.description: Placeholder in the chat input (also its accessible name)

properties.name: label
properties.default: "AI chat input above a glass keyboard and a moving colour gradient"
properties.description: Accessible name of the scene (the host is a group)

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-submit
events.description: A prompt was sent with Enter, by the demo or by the user. Detail: { text: string }

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Called when a prompt is sent with Enter – by the demo or by the user
